Implementation inference from documented primitives: store training-only transition counts as CSR with N+1 row pointers and E column/value entries: O(N+E) memory. Sampled scoring at every causal position queries (sequence[t], candidate), using binary search within sorted rows; full-catalog inference scatters that row into the existing SASRec score vector. Alternatively, encode edges as sorted int64 keys source×(N+1)+target: O(E) storage, vectorized searchsorted, O(Q log E) for Q queries. Check insertion bounds and exact equality; missing edges return zero. CSR favors row enumeration; edge keys simplify batched GPU queries. Neither needs an N² matrix. [CSR documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.sparse_csr_tensor), [searchsorted](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/torch.html).

A fully specified fixed lexical comparator: per category, concatenate available titles/descriptions; fit float32 word-unigram TF-IDF with lowercase=True, min_df=2, max_features=50,000, smooth_idf=True, sublinear_tf=True, norm='l2'. At position t, sum item vectors through t and L2-normalize; score candidates by dot product, returning zero for empty vectors. Nonnegative cosine lies in [0,1]. Store item features in CSR: O(N+V+Z), with vocabulary V and Z nonzeros. Incremental prefix pooling avoids storing every prefix, although pooled vectors can densify. Sampled scoring uses selected candidate rows; full-catalog scoring uses chunked sparse products. Avoid materializing all BL×N scores or an N×N similarity matrix. [TF-IDF](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.feature_extraction.text.TfidfVectorizer.html), [sparse multiplication](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.sparse.mm.html).

Proposed calibration: transition residual r=c(source,target)/max(1,total outgoing count), also bounded [0,1]; add αr to SASRec logits during training and inference. Compare baseline, ungated residual, support-gated residual g=n_source/(n_source+τ), and lexical residual under equal validation budgets. Report support coverage alongside macro validation HR@10; gating benefits remain an empirical question.
